name: Gayatri Mantra
text:
ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः
तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि
धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् ॥
meaning: We meditate upon the radiant light of Savitr, the source of life. May that light inspire and guide our understanding.
purpose: A Vedic prayer for illumination and inspired understanding.
when: In the morning, before study, or during meditation.
note: The core verse is Rigveda 3.62.10. The opening AUM and Bhur Bhuvah Svah are common in devotional recitation.
